topics.label: Introduction to inflammation initiation and resolution
topics.groupedBecause: It welcomes the students and outlines the lecture's focus on the mechanisms governing the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and damage recognition by pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how the innate immune system detects infection and tissue injury through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor signaling pathways.

topics.label: Cellular recruitment, trafficking, and systemic inflammatory responses
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how sentinel and endothelial cells coordinate leukocyte recruitment, extravasation, and tissue migration, along with the dangers of excessive systemic inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: They detail the mechanisms that terminate inflammation, drive tissue healing, and manage persistent inflammatory responses.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of complement system
topics.groupedBecause: It marks the end of the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on the complement system.
